statement: The evidence observes different stages: a described principle, household availability, delivered equipment, measured use and beneficial outcomes are not interchangeable. Hero’s source silence is an observation limit, not an observed failure to deploy.
counterevidence: Apparent stage differences may reflect missing records or differing measurement rather than failed use; where failure is observed, design, demand, exposure and operating work may each matter.
inference_limits: This is an evidence classification, not a test selecting maintenance, access or any general adoption mechanism. Missing ancient deployment remains unknown.

test.mechanism_chain: Stage and observation definition -> different permissible inference; no causal pathway is identified by this distinction.
test.strongest_rival: Apparent stage differences may reflect missing records or differing measurement rather than failed use; where failure is observed, design, demand, exposure and operating work may each matter.
test.discriminating_observation: Separate records that do not observe an outcome from studies that directly measure use and benefit; compare within the same intervention before inferring a failed link.
test.evidence_sought_found: Hero’s passage lacks productive-load observation. The stove follow-up directly records changing use/condition and health outcomes. The hearing-aid trial measures benefit, logged use and keep intention separately.
test.remaining_ambiguity: This is an evidence classification, not a test selecting maintenance, access or any general adoption mechanism. Missing ancient deployment remains unknown.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Observed material trade-offs, task-specific printing, hybrid textile inputs and lead-acid use reject automatic replacement by a newer technique. They do not distinguish freely chosen task fit from binding price, access or institutional constraints in every setting.
counterevidence: Persistence can follow cash scarcity, restricted access, customary obligation or script-sensitive costs even when a newer technique would be preferred under different constraints.
inference_limits: Historical motive shares are unresolved; model fit and reused niche observations are not independent confirmations. No optimality or consent follows from coexistence.

test.mechanism_chain: Different properties, tasks and feasible alternatives -> potential selective use or combination; the cause of each observed persistence must be tested separately.
test.strongest_rival: Persistence can follow cash scarcity, restricted access, customary obligation or script-sensitive costs even when a newer technique would be preferred under different constraints.
test.discriminating_observation: Observe feasible alternatives, prices, rights and comparable tasks; test whether changes in those constraints alter use without changing the technical properties.
test.evidence_sought_found: The printing niche observations also fit Angeles’s script-sensitive cost model; they refute impossibility, not that realistic rival. Lead-acid’s upfront cost contrast and the unsold elaborate clock constrain a simple performance hierarchy. The separately dated Guanzhong case observes cloth-coupon resale, cash scarcity and unpaid textile work alongside durability/social uses; this is not a backward projection into the pre-1949 episode.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Historical motive shares are unresolved; model fit and reused niche observations are not independent confirmations. No optimality or consent follows from coexistence.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Documented output rights, project sanctions, enslaved maintenance, provider incentives and customary governance require separate choosers, payers, operators and affected nonchoosers. Uptake cannot serve as their shared welfare measure.
counterevidence: Some divergent outcomes may reflect ecology, service quality or task differences alongside authority and incentives; recorded rules do not by themselves measure enforcement or individual welfare.
inference_limits: The cases are not matched institutional treatments. A local prescribing contrast does not supply the causal effect of all institutions or a complete welfare balance.

test.mechanism_chain: Rights, sanctions and revenue can alter different actors’ choices; observed institutions establish actor differences without identifying one general institutional effect.
test.strongest_rival: Some divergent outcomes may reflect ecology, service quality or task differences alongside authority and incentives; recorded rules do not by themselves measure enforcement or individual welfare.
test.discriminating_observation: Trace the actual authority, sanction, payment and refusal options; use incentive changes where available, and measure outcomes for each affected group.
test.evidence_sought_found: Carney records dated arrears and plot seizures with conditional return; Tae Rak documents opposed drainage; the prescribing audit changes expected dispensing location but retains distrust and design limitations. Northern Ghana adds competing accounts of paid recruitment, residual compulsion and farmer-initiated unpaid roads; administrative pay categories alone do not measure refusal.
test.remaining_ambiguity: The cases are not matched institutional treatments. A local prescribing contrast does not supply the causal effect of all institutions or a complete welfare balance.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Recurring work and inputs are documented in operating systems, but this corpus does not identify maintenance as the unique cause of persistence or reversal. Supported use and lower exposure can also coexist with a null clinical endpoint.
counterevidence: Design, task fit, ecology, exposure outside the intervention, changed alternatives or reverse causation from declining demand may explain the outcome.
inference_limits: Stove mediators remain bundled; no maintenance adequacy threshold inferred from failure is accepted. No universal necessity or effect size follows.

test.mechanism_chain: Hypothesised: provision/repair -> functioning use -> exposure or other service -> downstream outcome; each arrow may fail and feedback from demand may alter provision.
test.strongest_rival: Design, task fit, ecology, exposure outside the intervention, changed alternatives or reverse causation from declining demand may explain the outcome.
test.discriminating_observation: Define adequate provision before observing outcomes; trace condition, use, exposure and endpoints separately, with dated demand/design/ecology contrasts.
test.evidence_sought_found: The stove package included training/promoters yet use declined; HAPIN’s supported use/exposure contrast limits a low-use explanation of every health null. Chronometer service is directly documented; malaria resistance detection does not date onset. The dated feeder-road deterioration after fuel/export interruption is compatible with demand affecting maintenance, but does not isolate that arrow.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Stove mediators remain bundled; no maintenance adequacy threshold inferred from failure is accepted. No universal necessity or effect size follows.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Risk-contingent offers, full production cycles, complete journeys and input configurations change what is being compared. In the Ghana experiment, insurance-only offers increased investment and cash-only aggregate responses were smaller under the tested contracts; this does not rank constraints generally.
counterevidence: Liquidity, anticipated future cash needs, treatment value, delivery timing and task-specific costs may contribute alongside risk or psychological mechanisms.
inference_limits: Heterogeneous outcomes and treatment sizes cannot be pooled into a global ranking of risk, price or convenience. Original identification assumptions remain.

test.mechanism_chain: State-contingent risk relief or different timing/input configuration -> changed feasible action/payoff -> observed investment or service comparison.
test.strongest_rival: Liquidity, anticipated future cash needs, treatment value, delivery timing and task-specific costs may contribute alongside risk or psychological mechanisms.
test.discriminating_observation: Vary the specified contract/input/timing before the outcome; compare equal-valued alternatives where possible and retain cash responses for particular inputs.
test.evidence_sought_found: Ghana supplies a randomized local investment contrast; Kenya supplies profitable small-dose trials and offer timing effects without uniquely identifying present bias. The ancient transport and agricultural comparisons have weaker identification.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Heterogeneous outcomes and treatment sizes cannot be pooled into a global ranking of risk, price or convenience. Original identification assumptions remain.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: A useful task, entry to its work and capture of its returns are distinct. Incumbent telephone operators’ losses coexisted with no measured overall employment reduction for subsequent young female cohorts; maintenance entry was gendered, while other histories show negotiated compensation, tool barriers or unpaid participation.
counterevidence: Local labour demand, linked-sample selection and institutions governing entry/compensation may explain heterogeneous outcomes without any universal human comparative advantage.
inference_limits: No contemporary role passes a demand, access and value-capture validation gate in this edition; work may be automated, unpaid or inaccessible.

test.mechanism_chain: Task reallocation -> heterogeneous exposure, entry rights and bargaining -> potentially divergent livelihoods; this is not a demonstrated pathway into good work for all displaced people.
test.strongest_rival: Local labour demand, linked-sample selection and institutions governing entry/compensation may explain heterogeneous outcomes without any universal human comparative advantage.
test.discriminating_observation: Follow the same workers, measure entry costs and net returns, and compare entrants with incumbents and excluded people; do not substitute later cohorts for individual recovery.
test.evidence_sought_found: Telephone study and bargaining records observe different units; tool accumulation and unpaid voyaging demonstrate concrete access/pay distinctions without wage forecasts. Guanzhong unpaid work and Ghanaian asset/debt/labour conditions add concrete access and value-capture limits; no displaced-carrier transition panel is observed.
test.remaining_ambiguity: No contemporary role passes a demand, access and value-capture validation gate in this edition; work may be automated, unpaid or inaccessible.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Measurement and design boundaries materially change interpretation: UK VR gaming reports, ORT episode definitions, container estimates, completed overnight reactor costs and sequential hearing-aid prices cannot be read as comparable adoption or welfare effects.
counterevidence: An apparently different conclusion may arise from a different outcome or sample rather than a substantive contradiction.
inference_limits: Purposive checks do not estimate the bibliography’s error rate or invalidate the bounded observations.

test.mechanism_chain: Observation population/denominator/version/design -> reported quantity -> bounded interpretation.
test.strongest_rival: An apparently different conclusion may arise from a different outcome or sample rather than a substantive contradiction.
test.discriminating_observation: Inspect original question, denominator, omitted projects and assignment procedure before comparing headline results.
test.evidence_sought_found: Each cited case preserves a concrete definition or design qualification; overnight costs omit financing and completed samples omit cancellation, while hearing-aid price assignment was sequential.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Purposive checks do not estimate the bibliography’s error rate or invalidate the bounded observations.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: The acquired digital evidence leaves a universal portability-versus-performance ranking and the claim that most laptops cost less than most smartphones unestablished. It supports dated task/use comparisons and a bounded UK VR gaming minority-use result.
counterevidence: Prices, tariffs, distribution, software, network reach, ergonomics and constrained alternatives can accompany or substitute for portability.
inference_limits: Unestablished is not false. No current global VR failure or device-price verdict is claimed.

test.mechanism_chain: Bundled device/service attributes and access -> observed use; the data do not isolate a dominant attribute.
test.strongest_rival: Prices, tariffs, distribution, software, network reach, ergonomics and constrained alternatives can accompany or substitute for portability.
test.discriminating_observation: Obtain dated transaction-price distributions and designs separating attributes in specified tasks and populations.
test.evidence_sought_found: Inspected surveys describe device use/importance and task perceptions, not attribute intervention effects or the required price distributions.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Unestablished is not false. No current global VR failure or device-price verdict is claimed.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Production capability, low cost and local adoption require distinct observations. Procurement and production knowledge appear in bounded capability-building histories, but modeled scale/R&D/learning shares depend on definitions and do not identify a universal pathway.
counterevidence: Demand selection, imported equipment, material prices, redesign and model attribution rules can explain the same cost/output trends; cumulative output may be consequence as well as cause.
inference_limits: These are linked but different mechanisms, not independent estimates of one learning effect. No cost percentage is transportable without its model and period.

test.mechanism_chain: Specified buyers, tooling, skilled transfer or process development -> potential reliable production -> possible market access; deployment and capture require separate links.
test.strongest_rival: Demand selection, imported equipment, material prices, redesign and model attribution rules can explain the same cost/output trends; cumulative output may be consequence as well as cause.
test.discriminating_observation: Trace procurement/tooling/transfer before reliable output; compare local production with local use; test model sensitivity and cross-generation transfer.
test.evidence_sought_found: Chinese PV production/export contrast separates manufacture from domestic use; PV decompositions disagree on plant-size shares; DRAM learning is not reliably inherited across all generations; Hall’s gauges preserve measurement work.
test.remaining_ambiguity: These are linked but different mechanisms, not independent estimates of one learning effect. No cost percentage is transportable without its model and period.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Measured behaviour supports local intervention and expressed-meaning claims more strongly than universal psychological labels. Offer timing, summaries, communication incentives and bicycle packages have bounded effects; present bias, attention, reinforcement and psychological ownership remain incompletely separated from realistic rivals.
counterevidence: Computation, credibility, delivery convenience, contact exposure, selection, service quality and material access can mimic an attributed psychological mechanism.
inference_limits: Qualitative testimony is evidence of expressed meanings, not universal prevalence. Local package effects do not validate an invariant human motive.

test.mechanism_chain: Intervention changes information, effort, resources or social setting -> observed behaviour; latent motive identification needs additional contrasts.
test.strongest_rival: Computation, credibility, delivery convenience, contact exposure, selection, service quality and material access can mimic an attributed psychological mechanism.
test.discriminating_observation: Measure beliefs/constraints before uptake, compare mechanism-specific arms directly, and distinguish a significant effect in one arm from a significant difference between arms.
test.evidence_sought_found: Seaweed summaries bundle interpretation; Malawi gendered ratings do not yield a precise pooled adoption penalty; Zambia free/fee arms do not establish ownership effects; stigma interviews include dissenting participants.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Qualitative testimony is evidence of expressed meanings, not universal prevalence. Local package effects do not validate an invariant human motive.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Replication and dependable operation involve distinct material, measurement and learning arrangements. Documented laser copying, maintained gauges and navigator apprenticeship support bounded contributions. Failed visits limit contact sufficiency; successful rough electrodes limit strict-precision necessity. Universal contact necessity or precision sufficiency is not established by those observations.
counterevidence: Material differences, power-unit failures, instrumentation, selection of attempts and design robustness may explain success attributed to tacit transmission or precision.
inference_limits: Small historical series and partial 1975 access prevent exclusive causal attribution; successful operation does not establish reliability, safety or transferable livelihoods.

test.mechanism_chain: Tools/references, practice and communication -> potentially competent replication/operation; product design and testing can substitute for some skill demands.
test.strongest_rival: Material differences, power-unit failures, instrumentation, selection of attempts and design robustness may explain success attributed to tacit transmission or precision.
test.discriminating_observation: Record all attempted builds and changed variables; compare instruction/contact, tools/materials and independent performance tests, including failed contacts and successful rough components.
test.evidence_sought_found: Collins reports failed visits as well as contact-associated copies and does not rule out written-only success. Rough TEA electrodes limit strict-precision necessity across the reported configurations; they do not show that the blocked laboratory could succeed with the same substitution. K1 is one replication, not serial manufacture.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Small historical series and partial 1975 access prevent exclusive causal attribution; successful operation does not establish reliability, safety or transferable livelihoods.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism

statement: Institutions can preserve selected uses, alter obligations and distribute gains or exposure differently: Tokugawa gun niches, Yuan exchange practices, Qing connected-market risk, metric compromises and negotiated Tae Rak water levels do not have one common welfare or adoption sign.
counterevidence: Prices, ecology, security demand and material service constraints change alongside legal form, so law alone need not explain uptake.
inference_limits: Heterogeneous histories are analogical comparisons, not a pooled policy evaluation. Administrative records and abstract-only sources retain their stated limits.

test.mechanism_chain: Task-specific permissions, enforcement and access arrangements -> heterogeneous feasible use and distribution; no single institutional coefficient is inferred.
test.strongest_rival: Prices, ecology, security demand and material service constraints change alongside legal form, so law alone need not explain uptake.
test.discriminating_observation: Compare actual access/use and affected actors before and after specified arrangements; retain household practice, excluded sites and redistributed risk alongside legal deadlines or mean benefits.
test.evidence_sought_found: 1840 is a legal deadline, not universal uptake; telegraph access reduces price maxima but redistributes weather exposure; the 2010 water setting permits partial restoration with a named exclusion.
test.remaining_ambiguity: Heterogeneous histories are analogical comparisons, not a pooled policy evaluation. Administrative records and abstract-only sources retain their stated limits.
test.hypothesis_timing: retrospective synthesis; targeted revision after independent first-round criticism
